items.title: Conrad "Connie" Jones Interview, 1981-07-23, 08-03
items.q: This would be like...in fact, it was kind of like...this Miro Street, is that up around there? I think it was on Miro Street someplace.

ctx.x: No, no. This would be like...in fact, it was kind of like...this Miro Street, is that up around there? I think it was on Miro Street someplace.
Miro and Tom Tito right there.

Somewhere around there, if I'm not mistaken. But it was just the kids, and we played something like, I don't know, we might have gotten every bit of $25 for the whole job. And it was, we played, played, played, played. At that time we might have known ten tunes all together, the whole band, but we played and had a good time. The people danced and we thought we were terrific. And they probably did too. They had a good time. Sure.
